Because most applicants prefer y, x, and w over z, I suspect z will be very competitive. I also have a relatively good ranking at w and y (1st priority), but a lower ranking at z (2nd priority).

My strategy is to stick to my true preferences. While it might be tempting to rank y higher to increase my chances of a match, that would be a bad outcome if I *do* get y. Since I cannot lose, I should aim for my highest preference, even if the odds are lower. If z and x are both blocked, I'd rather have w than y.
